Week 22 Module Map: The Texas Constitution of 1876: Structure

Quarter 3: The Price of Union · Anchor date: 1876

Texas writes a constitution as a direct reaction against what Reconstruction-era government had been. To understand it, you have to understand what it was reacting to.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: The 1876 Texas Constitution: A Reaction to Reconstruction
  • Lesson 2: How Texas is Governed

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 22 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 22 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 22 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Self-government: notice a people writing limits on its own government.
